title: Keep request reads outside a shared use cache scope

hints: A shared cached scope should not read request cookies directly.
alternativeApproaches: No. A key partitions representations but does not validate current membership or define entitlement freshness. Apply server authorization before cache access and choose a revocation-compatible lifetime/invalidation strategy.
commonMistakes: Verifying only next dev when the behavior depends on production rendering or bundling.
Treating a visible UI state, matcher or TypeScript type as a substitute for server-side validation and authorization.
